title: Diagonal subsequence for countably many bounded real sequences
statement: Let ι be a countable type (universe u) and let a_k(i) ∈ ℝ (k ∈ ℕ, i ∈ ι). Suppose that for every i ∈ ι the sequence (a_k(i))_{k∈ℕ} is bounded, i.e. there is C_i ∈ ℝ with |a_k(i)| ≤ C_i for all k. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every i ∈ ι the sequence (a_{φ(k)}(i))_{k∈ℕ} converges in ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type u) [Countable ι] (a : ℕ → ι → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k, |a k i| ≤ C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i, ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => a (φ k) i) atTop (𝓝 l)
